hero.eyebrow: Cinematic edge motion · living canvas grain
hero.description: A cinematic study of mirrored glass edges, smooth Lenis scrolling, velocity-aware light, layered parallax and living 35mm film grain.

blur.title: BLUR
blur.description: The fixed edge layers remain visually transparent while adapting their blur and glow to page movement, with a fluid response that keeps the scene alive.

gradient.title: GRADIENT
gradient.description: The gradient is strongest at each viewport boundary and softly dissolves toward the content, mirrored from top to bottom. Grain subtly weaves with gate weave.

fade.title: FADE
fade.description: The masks dissolve the glass progressively, avoiding hard panel edges while parallax keeps the depth alive. Fine canvas grain adds a restrained cinematic texture.

card.label: Effect stack
card.value: inertia → velocity → parallax → glass edge → living grain
